```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="definitions"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="ORG" name="Organisation" processRef="process_1" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="process_1" isExecutable="false">
    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_MPOO" name="MPOO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Send_TempContinuation_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_MPON</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_GO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Reject_Invoice_MPOO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_MSPO" name="MSPO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Send_TempContinuation_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Send_AdditionalReadings_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Reject_Invoice_MSPO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_GO" name="GO">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Examine_TempContinuation_GO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Examine_AdditionalReadings_GO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Examine_EquipAcq_GO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="lane_MPNO" name="MPON">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Examine_EquipAcq_MPNO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision_Confirm_MPNO</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Start -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Start" />

    <!-- Split gateway -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Split" name="Bill type decision" />

    <!-- Tasks: sending bills -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Send_TempContinuation_MPOO"
               name="Send bill for temporary continuation of the metering point operations to GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Send_TempContinuation_MSPO"
               name="Send bill for temporary continuation of the measurement to GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Send_AdditionalReadings_MSPO"
               name="Send bill for additional readings to GO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_MPON"
               name="Send bill for equipment acquisition to MPON" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_GO"
               name="Send bill for equipment acquisition to GO" />

    <!-- Examine tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examine_TempContinuation_GO"
               name="Examine the bill for temporary continuation of the metering point operations" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examine_AdditionalReadings_GO"
               name="Examine the bill for additional readings" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examine_EquipAcq_GO"
               name="Examine the bill for equipment acquisition" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Examine_EquipAcq_MPNO"
               name="Examine the bill for equipment acquisition" />

    <!-- Decision gateways after examination -->
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" name="Confirm invoice?" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_MPNO" name="Confirm invoice?" />

    <!-- Confirmation / Rejection tasks -->
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MPOO"
               name="Confirm invoice with payment advice to MPOO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reject_Invoice_MPOO"
               name="Reject invoice of MPOO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MSPO"
               name="Confirm invoice with payment advice to MSPO" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reject_Invoice_MSPO"
               name="Reject invoice of MSPO" />

    <!-- End events -->
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirmed" name="Invoice confirmed" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rejected" name="Invoice rejected" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_start_to_split" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Gateway_Split" />

    <!-- From split to send tasks -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_to_send_MPOO_temp" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_TempContinuation_MPOO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">MPOO sends temporary continuation bill</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_to_send_MSPO_temp" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_TempContinuation_MSPO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">MSPO sends temporary continuation bill</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_to_send_MSPO_readings" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_AdditionalReadings_MSPO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">MSPO sends additional readings bill</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_to_send_MPOO_eq_MPON" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_MPON">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">MPOO sends equipment acquisition bill to MPON</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_split_to_send_MPOO_eq_GO" sourceRef="Gateway_Split" targetRef="Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_GO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">MPOO sends equipment acquisition bill to GO</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Send -> Examine -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MPOO_temp_send_to_examine_GO" sourceRef="Task_Send_TempContinuation_MPOO" targetRef="Task_Examine_TempContinuation_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MSPO_temp_send_to_examine_GO" sourceRef="Task_Send_TempContinuation_MSPO" targetRef="Task_Examine_TempContinuation_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MSPO_readings_send_to_examine_GO" sourceRef="Task_Send_AdditionalReadings_MSPO" targetRef="Task_Examine_AdditionalReadings_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MPOO_eq_send_to_examine_MPON" sourceRef="Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_MPON" targetRef="Task_Examine_EquipAcq_MPNO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_MPOO_eq_send_to_examine_GO" sourceRef="Task_Send_EquipAcq_MPOO_to_GO" targetRef="Task_Examine_EquipAcq_GO" />

    <!-- Examine -> Decision gateway -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_examine_GO_to_decision" sourceRef="Task_Examine_TempContinuation_GO" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_examine_add_readings_GO_to_decision" sourceRef="Task_Examine_AdditionalReadings_GO" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_examine_eq_GO_to_decision" sourceRef="Task_Examine_EquipAcq_GO" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_examine_eq_MPNO_to_decision" sourceRef="Task_Examine_EquipAcq_MPNO" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_MPNO" />

    <!-- Decision gateway -> Confirm / Reject (GO side) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_decision_GO_confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MPOO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Confirm</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_decision_GO_reject" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" targetRef="Task_Reject_Invoice_MPOO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Reject</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Decision gateway -> Confirm / Reject (MPON side) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_decision_MPNO_confirm" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_MPNO" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MPOO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Confirm</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_decision_MPNO_reject" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_MPNO" targetRef="Task_Reject_Invoice_MPOO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Reject</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- After confirmations / rejections for MSPO (these come from GO examination of MSPO bills) -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_examine_MSPO_to_decision_GO" sourceRef="Task_Examine_TempContinuation_GO" targetRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" />
    <!-- Re‑use same decision gateway; add conditional flows for MSPO -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_decision_GO_confirm_MSPO" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" targetRef="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MSPO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Confirm</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_decision_GO_reject_MSPO" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision_Confirm_GO" targetRef="Task_Reject_Invoice_MSPO">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                                xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">Reject</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>

    <!-- Confirm / Reject -> End -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_confirm_to_end" sourceRef="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MPOO" targetRef="End_Confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_confirm_MSPO_to_end" sourceRef="Task_Confirm_Invoice_to_MSPO" targetRef="End_Confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_reject_to_end" sourceRef="Task_Reject_Invoice_MPOO" targetRef="End_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F_reject_MSPO_to_end" sourceRef="Task_Reject_Invoice_MSPO" targetRef="End_Rejected" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```

We need to model this process. The description is about bills being sent from MPOO or MSPO to GO, etc. Need to parse steps.

Actors: organization (pool) includes actors: MPOS? Actually MPOO, MSPO, GO, MPON (maybe other). The text mentions the organisation (presumably the company) and external parties? The instruction: "one pool for the organisation and one lane for each actor (a person, role, department or system) that performs activities. If the text names no actor, use a single lane."

We have actors: MPOO, MSPO, GO, MPON. They are presumably internal participants? We'll put them as lanes in the same pool (the organisation). Optionally could be external pools? The description says "if the MPOO sends ... to GO" (MPOO and GO both are within organisation maybe). We'll treat all as lanes.

Process steps:

1. Start event.

2. There are multiple possible bills that could be sent. This is a decision based on who sends which bill. Possibly parallel? Actually it's conditional: If the MPOO sends the bill for temporary continuation of the metering point operations to the GO, GO examines the bill. If the MSPO sends the bill for temporary continuation of the measurement to the GO, GO examines the bill. If the MSPO sends the bill for additional readings to the GO, GO examines the bill. If the MPOO sends the bill for the equipment acquisition to the MPON or the GO, the MPON or the GO examines the bill.

Basically, the process has multiple alternative incoming triggers: different actors send different bills. The processing after receipt is that GO or MPON examines the bill.

We can model as a start event leading to an exclusive gateway ("Which bill is sent?") with branches for each case.

Branches:

A) MPOO sends bill for temporary continuation of the metering point operations to GO → GO examines bill.

B) MSPO sends bill for temporary continuation of the measurement to GO → GO examines bill.

C) MSPO sends bill for additional readings to GO → GO examines bill.

D) MPOO sends bill for equipment acquisition to MPON → MPON examines bill. (or GO examines if sent to GO) So there are two sub-branches: either sent to MPON or sent to GO. Could combine as "MPOO sends bill for equipment acquisition to MPON or GO" leading to examination by whichever receives. We'll model as two branches perhaps.

We then have after examination, the GO or MPON confirms the invoice with payment advice to the MPOO or MSPO, or rejects the invoice of MPOO or MSPO.

So after exam, there is a decision: confirm or reject.

If confirm, then send confirmation with payment advice to the sender (MPOO or MSPO). If reject, then send rejection to the sender.

We need tasks for "examine the bill", "confirm the invoice with payment advice", "reject the invoice". The actors for these tasks: GO or MPON depending on who examined.

But we can model examine task as performed by GO (or MPON). Could have two separate examine tasks: "examine the bill (GO)" and "examine the bill (MPON)". We'll assign lanes accordingly.

Similarly, confirm/reject tasks are performed by GO or MPON (the examiner). So tasks may be lane-specific.

Sequence:

Start → exclusive gateway "Bill type / sender" → For each case:

Case A: Task "Send bill for temporary continuation of the metering point operations (MPOO to GO)" maybe it's sending action performed by MPOO, but the description is about sending to GO. We may include sending as a task? The description says "If the MPOO sends the bill ... the GO examines the bill." So the sending is an activity by MPOO. That's optional but since each activity should be a task. So we should model sending tasks.

Thus:

- Task in lane MPOO: "Send bill for temporary continuation of the metering point operations to GO"

- Then flow to GO task: "Examine the bill (temporary continuation of the metering point operations)"? Could reuse same examine task name. The GO examines.

Similarly for other branches.

For equipment acquisition case:

- Task in MPOO: "Send bill for equipment acquisition to MPON" (or to GO). Actually two possibilities: to MPON or to GO. We can model two branches: one to MPON, one to GO.

- Then examine task by MPON or GO.

After examination, decision gateway "Confirm or reject invoice". Following confirm: task "Confirm invoice with payment advice to MPOO" (if original sender MPOO) or "Confirm invoice with payment advice to MSPO". We need separate tasks based on sender.

Similarly reject: task "Reject invoice of MPOO" or "Reject invoice of MSPO".

Thus many branches.

Alternative: we can simplify by having after examine, exclusive gateway with condition "Confirm?" leading to confirm or reject tasks, each sending to appropriate party based on original sender; we could incorporate decision variable but for modeling we need separate tasks per sender.

Thus for each original bill case we will have separate confirm/reject tasks.

Total tasks:

- Send bill temporary continuation (MPOO) -> examine by GO -> decision -> confirm/reject to MPOO.

- Send bill temporary continuation measurement (MSPO) -> examine by GO -> decision -> confirm/reject to MSPO.

- Send bill additional readings (MSPO) -> examine by GO -> decision -> confirm/reject to MSPO.

- Send bill equipment acquisition to MPON (MPOO) -> examine by MPON -> decision -> confirm/reject to MPOO.

- Send bill equipment acquisition to GO (MPOO) -> examine by GO -> decision -> confirm/reject to MPOO.

We could merge last two as same path but keep distinct.

Thus structure:

Start → ExclusiveGateway (G1) with 5 outgoing flows (named maybe "MPOO temp continuation", "MSPO temp continuation", "MSPO additional readings", "MPOO equipment acquisition to MPON", "MPOO equipment acquisition to GO") leading to corresponding send task.

After send task, flow goes to examine task (GO or MPON). They could be separate.

We'll create separate confirm tasks for each case attached after examine tasks before G2? Actually G2 is after each examine, so each examine could lead directly to its own confirm/reject exclusive gateway.

Simplify: after each examine task, have exclusive gateway G_confirm (maybe per branch) with two flows to confirm task and reject task, then end events.

Thus number of end events: confirm ends with End (maybe "Invoice confirmed") and reject ends "Invoice rejected". Both can be same end event name but separate ids. Could use a single end event for both? But each path must end. Could converge to parallel end?
